improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
improve.coach: 39% of matches, right in line with your recent form. A good one to drill.

improve.title: Shot selection
tips: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.
improve.coach: Steady at about 30% of matches. Steady means fixable; it's a habit, not a fluke.

strengths.title: Chance creation

strengths.title: Goal threat

strengths.title: Getting shots off
